newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares mixed in higher turnover.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares mixed in higher turnover.

text.p: 1040 GMT - Polish shares were mixed in higher trade after a three-day fall and buying was stronger after price-fixing.
* The main market's WIG index rose 94.7 points, or 0.6 percent, to 15,996.9, the WIG 20 rose 1.3 percent to 1,605.6 and the parallel market's WIRR rose 0.1 percent to 3,404.0.
* Turnover rose 17.6 percent to 137.6 million zlotys on all three markets as 53 issues fell, 38 rose and 15 were flat.

* The National Investment Fund NIF index fell 2.2 percent to 151.2 points in a turnover of 41.1 million zlotys. NFI units fell 2.6 percent to 148 zlotys in a turnover of 8.3 million zlotys. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
